title: Jubilesta and Stevedore Serenade
summary: Cootie played the lead on Jubilesta; he knows nothing of Stevedore Serenade.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose

blocks.x: "Jubilesta, Jubilesta." That was a nice tune that Cootie recorded. Cootie played the lead chorus on "Jubilesta" in the recording. Just like I said, Duke would just make the arrangements and we would record them.
Oh, I don't know anything about that.
